# 27,162 rows, 24-byte records, uint32 key (= typeID), hash on
# key % 27162 buckets. The record is two list pointers; the data is in the
# arena -- 648,930 attribute values and 54,336 effect entries in total.
# Every field name, offset and type below was read out of the client's own
# generated loader, bin64/typeDogmaLoader.pyd, and is reproducible with
# `tools/dogma.py derive typedogma`. The two element strides come from the
# generated sequence-item functions' own index arithmetic (`shl rbx, 4` for
# NOT the table. This is the single biggest content lever in the client and
# it stays in the client: the rows below exist only to show the reader
# produces the published EVE numbers, and anyone who wants the data obtains
# element of dogmaAttributes: stride 16 bytes, offsets relative to the element
# element of dogmaEffects: stride 8 bytes, offsets relative to the element
# the whole table is 27,162 rows carrying 648,930 attribute values; it is not here.
